claims.statement: Such an algebraic action cannot be any logarithm branch of a nontrivial nonzero algebraic target, in particular positive log(p); beta zero has no logarithm and beta one retains only the algebraic zero branch.

claims.statement: Fixed algebraic scales, averages, repetitions, real parts, imaginary parts, and moduli remain algebraic and obey the same direct prime-log exclusion.
